name: Cessna 170
summary: Four-seat tailwheel Cessna from 1948–56 and direct predecessor of the 172; in essence a 172 on conventional gear.

wings: High wing braced by a V-strut (early 170) or one strut per side (170A/B)
engines: Single flat-six in a slim, round cowling
fuselage: Four-seat cabin with one door per side
Fixed spring-steel main gear with a tailwheel
Rear side windows, elliptical on early models, squarer from 1955
tail: Swept-back fin and rudder shared with the 190/195

tellTales: Four-seat strut-braced high-wing with a tailwheel and a slim nose
Flat spring-steel main gear legs and a slim round nose
Swept-back fin and rudder over a tailwheel

confusedWith.howToTell: The 170 sits on a tailwheel with a nose-high ground stance; the 172 has a nosewheel and a squared or swept fin.
The 170 has a slimmer cowl and a smaller fin; the 180 has a bigger cowl and a taller swept fin.
The 170 has a slim flat-engine nose; the 195 has a big round radial engine and a deeper cowl.
The 170 is a larger four-seater with a longer cabin and a third side window; the 140 is a short two-seater.
